ValidationRule.description: The Root Cause is required when Case status is Resolved.The epic for reference #1008#14967. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType_Name__c ="Global Service Case",RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations"), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Root_Cause__c, "" ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Resolved" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Root Cause is required to resolve the case.
